notes.title: CHALLENGES!
notes.content:
[h2] WOOOO HOOOOOOO BABY! [/h2]

Granny's back in town, and she brought a new update:
[b]Challenges[/b].

You can now find challenges around the island to compete in and get some extra XP!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Jumper challenge added
[*] Speed challenge added
[*] Bumpersticker challenge added
[*] Terrain and collision fixes
[*] Added tooltip for new keyboard players
[*] Challenge data is cloudsaved (and might be used later...)
[*] General optimisations
[*] Voiceline Oh Yeah frequency lowered
[*] Voiceline Wooohooo baby frequency lowered
[*] Voicelines come at more appropriate times in the game
[*] More voicelines added
[*] Windmill achievement fix (thank you, YMYRO)
[*] Windmill animation fix
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for November 6th 2024
notes.content:
[h2]06/11/2024[/h2]

[list]
[*] Voicelines added: Legendary, Vroom, Aughh, Slow tree hit, Boosting
[*] Achievements fixes
[*] Lower game file size and performance optimisations
[*] SFX added: slow tree thud
[*] School collision small fix
[*] Terrain collision fixes
[*] Boost unlock level lowered to 3
[*] Boost visualization made more intuitive
[*] Children now spawn randomly on the road; more massacre to be committed!
[*] Garage UI exit button shortcut ---> boost button (B/Circle)
[*] Stuck button on all controllers (Menu/Start/R/Options)
[/list]

[b]More content coming soon![/b]
